title: BlackHeart Bike Co Road Ti
content:
Today, BlackHeart Bike Co. introduces the new evolution of Road Ti. A reflection of modern carbon aesthetics in a metal form, built to last. The latest version brings over the 3D-printed details that make a difference, first introduced on the Road Plus Ti earlier this year, making BlackHeart’s Road Ti a fast, refined road bike…

Road Ti Details

The ride stays true to the original. Premium 3/2.5 double-butted titanium tubing and dropped, slightly curved seatstays deliver a smooth yet snappy ride, while a kammtail downtube, one-piece carbon cockpit, and fully integrated cabling give little away to the fastest bikes on the road, regardless of material. Pro fit geometry keeps the handling quick and sharp. It carries forward the ride characteristics that earned the previous Road Ti Cyclingworld Europe’s 2024 Best Race Bike award, now paired with a more refined, modern platform.

The same thoughtful 3D-printed frame elements found on the Road Plus Ti, named one of Bicycling Magazine’s 2026 Best Bikes, now come to the Road Ti. A seamless seat tube cutout adds tire clearance and room for fenders. The T47-68 bottom bracket shell features a lower channel with a retaining clip for cleaner brake hose routing, while a solid brake mount with a self-guiding hose port makes building and servicing the bike simpler.

Finishing

Each frame is reamed, chased, and faced at the factory, ensuring it is build-ready straight out of the box. Consistent with the entire BlackHeart line, the Road Ti is backed by a lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects for the original owner.

In collaboration with ENVE, SRAM and Zipp, signature launch editions are now also available.

BlackHeart Road Ti Geo

BlackHeart also offers its Perfect Fit Program to help riders get it right the first time. Riders can book a free 30-minute 1:1 consultation with the team to dial in size, build spec, and geometry, using their own measurements and current bike as a reference point. It’s part of a human-first approach to customer service, backed by a fit guarantee: if a rider who completed the Perfect Fit Program is unhappy with their size, BlackHeart covers shipping to swap it for a different frame size.

Road Ti Specs

  • BlackHeart Road Ti Frameset – $3,499
    • Includes frame, ENVE fork, seatpost, headset
    • +$300 for custom fork paint – we can match any automotive paint available BlackHeart Road Ti Signature Builds – starting from $5,799
    • Includes BlackHeart Carbon barstem, SRAM Rival AXS or Shimano 105 Di2 groupset, and Hunt Allroad Alloy wheels.
  • BlackHeart Road Ti ENVE Edition – $13,749
    • SRAM Red AXS 2X Power groupset, ENVE SES Aero Pro barstem V2, ENVE SES 4.5 Pro Carbon wheelset, ENVE Carbon seatpost,
    • CeramicSpeed Alpha BB
    • Size 56 = 17 lbs 0 oz
    • BlackHeart Road Ti Zipp Edition – $13,499
    • SRAM Red AXS 2X Power groupset, Zipp SL 80 Race Carbon Handlebar with Zipp SL Service Course Alloy stem, Zipp 202 NSW wheelset,
    • BlackHeart Carbon seatpost, CeramicSpeed Alpha BB
    • Size 56 = 16 lbs 12 oz
  • Available in 9 sizes to fit riders from 5’0″ to 6’7’
  • Tire clearance up to 700x35mm (with fenders)
  • 100% recyclable premium 3/2.5 double-butted titanium tubing
  • 3D-printed details carried over from the Road Plus Ti for real-world usability Removable direct mount front derailleur hanger
  • Cane Creek HCR headset, T47-68 bottom bracket, Round 31.6mm seatpost, UDH
  • 2x/1x electronic

The new Road Ti will be in stock in November at blackheartbikeco.com and through BlackHeart’s growing dealer network.
